en.topic_title: Tai Po fire: Renovation directors denied knowledge of combustible materials and bid-rigging despite contrary evidence
en.topic_summary:
Two directors at the renovation firm that oversaw works at Wang Fuk Court when a deadly fire broke out last November denied knowing that substandard, combustible materials were being used at the estate, according to witness testimonies made accessible to the public.
